how_to_read: The record check shows ONLY entries in this file whose status is verify_before_relying, and always with that label. UNVERIFIED entries are placeholders for research: they have no url and are never shown to a person. No other url or statute may appear in a checklist except one the person typed themself. Every entry stays verify_before_relying until a research pass confirms it; then the reviewer may add a confirmed date. Descriptions say what a source is about, never what it means for one person.
